items.title: Caliber Auto Glass acquires Arrow Auto Glass
items.summary: Texas-based Caliber Auto Glass has acquired Arrow Auto Glass, expanding its footprint across four additional states.

items.title: Crawford executives highlight role of insurance in EU climate framework
items.summary: Crawford & Company leaders examine how the European Commission's climate framework and the claims sector can address adaptation.

items.title: Serious Fraud Office charges eight individuals over London Capital & Finance collapse
items.summary: The Serious Fraud Office has brought charges against eight people as part of its ongoing investigation into the collapse of London Capital & Finance.

items.title: Stand Launches Homeowners Insurance across Colorado with wildfire mitigation discounts
items.summary: Specialty insurer Stand is expanding its homeowners insurance coverage into Colorado, offering premium reductions for properties implementing wildfire protection measures.

items.title: USQRisk appoints Ross Paltridge deputy chief underwriting officer
items.summary: USQRisk names former Swiss Re executive Ross Paltridge as deputy chief underwriting officer for international and London markets.

items.title: FCA charges Raymond Fieldhouse with money laundering offences over investment scams
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority has charged Raymond Fieldhouse with laundering more than £1.42m derived from investment scams.
